reflections.title: Waiting for God's Appointed Time

reflect.text: When we wait on God, His mercy can seem slow, but it is always certain. We are often in a hurry, eager to see His blessings right away. Yet the Lord sets His own time with perfect wisdom, and His timing is always best. As Charles Spurgeon noted, "He never is before His time; He never is behind."

When we have waited for a long time, we might be tempted to fear that God's word has failed or gone silent. But God's promise is a living word on its way from the living God. It will speak, and it will never lie. No promise of His will ever be delayed past the day He appointed for it.

Because God is completely faithful, our task is simply to have patience. We do not need to fret or rush ahead. Instead, we can calm our souls, rest in Him, and wait with quiet peace for what He will surely do.

questions: In what area of your life do you feel in a hurry for God to act?
How can trusting God's perfect timing help you rest quietly today?
reflections.prayer: Lord, forgive us when we grow impatient and fear that Your help has been delayed. Remind us that Your living word never fails and Your timing is always best. Teach our souls to rest in You and wait with quiet peace. Amen.
